# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not put sensitive vulnerability details, credentials, personal data, employer-confidential information, or real Human Model contents into a public issue.

If the issue is purely conceptual and contains no sensitive details, open an issue with a minimal reproduction.

For vulnerabilities that require private disclosure, contact the repository maintainer through an appropriate private GitHub/contact channel and provide only the minimum information necessary.

## Scope

This repository is primarily an architecture/template. Security concerns may include:

- instructions that encourage secret leakage,
- unsafe autonomous modification of permission boundaries,
- evaluator manipulation that bypasses protected constraints,
- path/routing designs that cause accidental disclosure across domains,
- tooling contributed later to automate learning or execution.

## User responsibility

Real Human Model repositories may contain highly sensitive data. Keep them private and follow employer, client, legal, regulatory, and organizational policies applicable to the data and actions involved.
